provenance.method: BBC/Open University programme identity and purpose reviewed on 2026-09-05; listed as documentary/lived-experience media, not assessment.

name: Inside Our Autistic Minds — BBC / Open University
description: Documentary series in which autistic people work with Chris Packham to communicate aspects of their lived experience through film.
intended_use: Inspect documentary representations of autistic lived experience and communication without treating the programme as a clinical model.
audience_or_context: Primarily UK-origin media with international informational relevance; availability depends on broadcaster/platform rights.
limitations: A documentary selects particular people and stories and is not representative of every autistic person.
Programme availability may vary by territory and rights window.
cost_or_access_notes: Viewing availability depends on broadcaster/platform and territory; the Open University page provides programme context.
conflicts_of_interest: BBC and the Open University co-produced/supported the programme; ND Oracle lists it as media rather than independent efficacy evidence.
